name: Chosen Bible
title: Chosen Bible
sub: For the Fatherless, Foster Youth, Adoptive and Foster Families, Youth Aging Out of Care, and Anyone Raised Without a Father

hook.h2: He did not send someone. He said He would come Himself
hook.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
son: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
hook.note: Jesus said this to men who were about to lose Him, and He chose the word orphan on purpose. He did not promise to arrange something for them or hand them to someone else — He said He would come Himself. In this Bible those words are printed in RED, because you should be able to see with your eyes that the promise came from His mouth and not from a preacher's.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Scripture does not treat the fatherless as a problem to be managed. It names our Father as a father to the fatherless, settling the lonely into a home. And the Son says it plainly: He will not leave you as an orphan; He will come to you.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive The Father. Hear His Voice. His Heart Is For You.
body: The Chosen Bible is a color coded Bible for the fatherless, foster youth, adoptive and foster families — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.

long.h: Before Anyone Chose You, Your Father Had Already Chosen You. He Is Not A Placement, And He Does Not Change His Mind.
body: Scripture speaks to this directly, and it does not speak of the fatherless as a problem to be managed. It names our Father as the One who takes the place no one else took, and who settles the lonely into a family of His own making. "A father to the fatherless and defender of widows is our Father in his holy dwelling." — Psalm 68:5

The Son said it Himself, and in these pages you will see His words in red: "I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you." — John 14:18 It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Chosen Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — bound and opened for someone who grew up without a father in the house. The cover is its own, and so are the first pages: an opening word that says before anyone chose you, your Father had already chosen you, and passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance chosen for the Chosen. Everything after Genesis 1:1 is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is this only for children in foster care?
faq.a: It was made for the fatherless of any age — foster youth and youth aging out of care, adopted adults, anyone whose father died, left, or was never named. Our Father is not waiting for a category to fit you. He says “I will be his Father, and he will be my son” and He means whoever will receive Him, at whatever age they come.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a young person aging out of care?
faq.a: It was written with that reader in mind. It is a complete hardcover Bible with a presentation page for their name, which matters when most of what someone leaves care with is paperwork rather than possessions. It is not a children's Bible and it is not abridged — it reads at the same level as every other edition and carries them into adulthood.

faq.q: The word father is hard for me. Why would I want this Bible?
faq.a: Because that is the reader it was written for. The Father revealed in these pages is not a bigger version of the father you had. He is the original, the Father from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name — and the point of the color is that you never have to take someone else's word for what He said. You can see it.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy it?
faq.a: Yes. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read online in twenty-five languages at fathersheartbible.com/read, with English and Telugu also free to listen to. Nobody has to buy anything to receive our Father's voice — the print edition is for holding, giving, and handing on.
